messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: High tail latency observed for single-tenant customer 'EchoCo' (p99 > 2s). Paging on-call.

maria (oncall): I'm on it, grabbing context. What channel is this hitting? streaming or sync?

alex (sre): saw spikes on their dedicated pool - mostly streaming endpoints, but some sync generate calls also show p99 spikes. p95 mostly fine.

jasper (eng): any unusual prompt shapes? customer mentioned they batch multi-turn transcripts into one huge prompt earlier.

lina (csm): EchoCo reports a sudden increase in multi-line prompts after a change to their ingestion pipeline ~09:12 UTC. They saw degraded UX and some aborted sessions.

maria (oncall): ok i'm attaching traces. ops-bot, pull last 10 traces for customer=echoco, timeframe=09:10-09:25

ops-bot: Retrieved 10 traces. Top issues: 6/10 show KV cache misses + long prefix handling; average token generation time spikes after 512 tokens.

alex (sre): here's a quick grep from the runtime logs for one RequestID:

```
RequestID: rq-0x4f2a
customer: echoco
model_variant: redwood-13b-ctx2
duration_total: 3.12s
p99_segment: 2.6s (generation tail)
note: kvcache-miss count=7, long-prefix=true, stream-chunk-retry=1
```

jasper (eng): that pattern matches a long-prefix + KV cache eviction causing repeated recomputation for the tail. At high concurrency KC thrash shows up as p99.

kevin (infra): current pool utilization for EchoCo dedicated nodes is 88%. We can spin a temporary extra node in the dedicated cluster (hot spare) to ease KV pressure. Want me to scale?

maria (oncall): yes +1 node now. Also applying a quick routing rule to send new streaming sessions for EchoCo to the lower concurrency backup pool for 15m.

ops-bot: Routing rule applied: echoco -> dedicated-pool-b for new sessions. Scale action: provision request submitted (node:+1), ETA ~2m.

lina (csm): FYI I'm already on a call with EchoCo support. I'll tell them we're routing and scaling, ask them to pause bulk promptting for a few minutes.

jasper (eng): short-term mitigation ideas:
- route to backup pool (done)
- reduce per-session concurrent streams limit for customer to 4
- increase KV cache per-session quota (risk: memory)
- rollback recent client-side batching (if they can)

maria (oncall): i'll set concurrency cap to 4 for echoco. jasper can you check if increasing KV cache helps without OOM risk?

jasper (eng): running a dry check: projected mem increase ~7% on backup pool, looks safe with +1 node. I'll push a temp config to increase KV cache age/size.

alex (sre): after routing applied p99 down from 2.6s -> 1.1s on new sessions. Old sessions still show stalls.

maria (oncall): marking customer impact: degraded UX for live streams, partial aborts. severity: sev2 -> might escalate if persists. Notifying PagerDuty.

lina (csm): echoCo confirmed UX improved for new sessions, but asks when old sessions will recover. I'm going to suggest clients restart long-lived sessions.

kevin (infra): node provision completed and joined cluster at 09:18 UTC.

ops-bot: KV cache config change deployed to dedicated-pool-b (temp). Monitoring.

jasper (eng): initial metrics look good: p99 for EchoCo across cluster now ~950ms. KV miss-rate down by ~62% in traces.

alex (sre): please keep an eye on stream chunk retries, we saw a few 429-ish backpressure events earlier; might need to tune batching window next.

maria (oncall): summary of immediate actions taken:
- routing rule -> dedicated-pool-b (15m)
- provisioned +1 node
- increased KV cache quota (temp)
- per-customer concurrency cap set to 4
- CSM notified, asked customer to restart long-lived sessions

lina (csm): customer request: can we get a short writeup on root cause and recommended long-term fixes? they want to avoid changing their client again.

jasper (eng): root cause (prelim): large multi-turn prompts cause long prefixes that stress KV cache; under high concurrency KV eviction leads to recomputation and streaming tail stalls. Long-term fixes: stronger prefix summarization, adaptive KV sizing, smarter eviction policy, or recommend chunking at client-side.

maria (oncall): creating incident ticket and postmortem stub. tagging eng-runtime and infra for deeper follow-up. I'll handoff to overnight oncall at 09:30 UTC.

alex (sre): leaving a runbook note: if p99 > 1.5s for >10m -> route, scale, and consider temporary per-customer concurrency cap. Also collect 100 sample traces and logs for eng.

maria (oncall): handoff to jasper for follow-up on fixes; i'm signing off this active triage. If it regresses re-open PD. :thumbsup:

jasper (eng): got it. I'll own follow-ups and coordinate with EchoCo for client-side mitigations. Will produce a short postmortem and action items by EOD.

lina (csm): thanks team — EchoCo says the UI looks back to normal. I'll keep them posted and close loop after postmortem.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-482 (linked).
